name: Eid Alkhaldi
title: AI Systems Architect for Regulated Enterprises
headline: Most teams can access the same models. My work is deciding what can be trusted, what must be verified, and how AI becomes an auditable system inside regulated Arabic-English workflows.
availability: Applied AI, insurance workflows, evaluation, and Arabic-English enterprise systems.
summary: The durable advantage is not tool access. It is the ability to turn uncertain model behavior into evidence, controls, review points, and operating routines that a real institution can defend.

My background combines a PhD in Electrical Engineering, first-author research in computer vision and optimization, and delivery experience across insurance, compliance-oriented automation, and bilingual Arabic-English enterprise environments.

edge.title: Evaluation Before Automation
edge.body: I start with what must be proven: evidence recall, decision correctness, exception behavior, citation faithfulness, audit trail quality, and conditions for abstention.

edge.title: Regulated Workflow Judgment
edge.body: Insurance and compliance work require authority boundaries, human review, policy interpretation, exception handling, and a record of why a decision was made.

edge.title: Arabic-English Enterprise Reality
edge.body: Bilingual systems fail in specific ways: translated clauses drift, local terminology matters, dialect changes intent, and document hierarchy can decide the answer.

edge.title: Research-Trained ML Judgment
edge.body: Doctoral research and first-author publications shaped a habit of controlled comparison, reproducibility, and skepticism toward unsupported model claims.

projects.title: Insurance AI Decision Systems
projects.body: Work on underwriting, claims, fraud indicators, audit trails, and human review. The technical challenge is inseparable from policy interpretation, authority, exception handling, and operational adoption.

projects.title: Agentic and Retrieval Architectures
projects.body: Architecture for systems where retrieval, tool calls, memory, policy constraints, model evaluation, and auditability are treated as one control surface.

projects.title: Arabic-English AI Evaluation
projects.body: Evaluation for systems that must handle Arabic and English documents, translated policy language, local terminology, dialectal intent, and evidence hierarchy.

projects.title: Medical Image AI Research
projects.body: First-author research on ensemble optimization and histology image classification, with emphasis on reproducible experimentation and model behavior under constraint.

principles: Evidence is part of the product, not an afterthought.
Human review should be designed as a control, not inserted as a vague fallback.
Arabic fluency is not enough; evaluation must test meaning, evidence, and decision behavior.
Agentic systems need session integrity: calls, arguments, state changes, permissions, and outputs must be replayable.
The best AI architecture reduces institutional uncertainty rather than hiding it behind a fluent interface.
